title: Agility Website
description: Website redesign and the visual system that had to survive it.

caseStudy.blurb: A redesign of agilityrobotics.com with Upstatement, built in parallel with the company rebrand so the new identity carried through to Agility's most visible touchpoint.
caseStudy.team: Brand Designer (me), Brand Director, Upstatement, Chief Business Officer
caseStudy.teamHtml: Brand Designer (me), Brand Director, Upstatement, Chief Business Officer
objectives: Translate an in-progress brand identity into a consistent, buildable web system.
Keep the site and the rebrand converging instead of drifting apart.
Make the product clear to both technical evaluators and operations buyers.
caseStudy.contribution: I led visual strategy from inside Agility, connecting the brand team, Upstatement, and business stakeholders. I locked the stable parts of the identity early (grid, type hierarchy, photographic treatment) and isolated unresolved decisions to single components, so late brand changes stayed cheap.
results: A site built on a visual system that held up as the rebrand landed.
Grid, type, and photography applied consistently across every page template.
Pages that lead with demonstration and let each audience go as deep as they need.
